GenAiFunction.description: Handles any customer reply to the question the journey is waiting for: name and mobile, OTP, loan confirmation, the 5 personalisation answers, offer decision, amount or tenure change, callback time and feedback. It routes on the saved journey state, so pass the customer message exactly as typed. Always pass journeyId = the journeyId output of the most recent LoanSeva action in this conversation (empty on the first call) and sessionId = the Routable Id (MessagingSession Id) of this conversation; leave sessionId empty if no Routable Id is available.
